name: Seafood and fish markets

problems.words: Fish not sold by afternoon loses value, by night it's gone
quick_ideas: Note what's unsold each evening by species, so buying follows what moves
Mark down earlier in the day rather than at night, while the fish still has value.

never_say: Anything about fishing seasons, species bans or export certification.
Customs, sanitary or food-safety rules — refer to their clearing agent or the authority.
Help mislabelling species or origin, or over-glazing to add weight.
Help under-invoicing exports or moving cash informally.
That margins will improve by any amount or currency moves can be avoided.
